# Video replay fixture

`video_detect_1.json` is an unchanged copy of the first successful real analysis at
`output/manual/0002/model_calls/video_detect_3.json` on 2026-09-12. The fixture
filename denotes the first request in this replay scenario; its original
`sequence: 3`, timestamps, prompt, response, usage, and model version are preserved.
Previous failed requests remain in the ignored manual-output directories and are
documented in spec 0002's status evidence. No video or secret is included here.

The `empty/` scenario is explicitly hand-written, as allowed by spec 0002.
